title: Map Generation from Satellite Imagery (Cross-Autoencoder Training and Inference)
description: Training-side companion code of the article 'Learned versus Classical Structural Representations for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization by Template Matching: A Cross-Source Map Benchmark and Flight Replay' (submitted to the International Journal of Engineering and Geosciences): data preparation from paired satellite-cartographic imagery, configurable autoencoder/U-Net training, tile-based batch inference, lossless mosaicking and georeferenced GeoTIFF output. Dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0.
